newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower on bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower on bearish sentiment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower, off early highs, on Monday on bearish sentiment caused by retail investors' selling in the over-bought market, brokers said.
Prices fell as retail investors squared their positions before Tuesday's settlement day, one broker said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 23.03 points, or 1.44 percent, lower at 1,575.91 after rising to 1,607.94 in early trade. Losers led gainers 214 to 60.
PTCL fell 0.50 rupee to 29, HUBCO 0.15 to 37.40, ICI 0.20 to 23.95 and PSO 5.00 to 280. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
